newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutz plans to sell subsidiaries.
newsitem.headline: Deutz plans to sell subsidiaries.

text.p: German machinery maker Deutz AG said on Tuesday it planned to sell its environmental technology and Indumont units by June 30.

The company said in a statement that concrete negotiations were under way with potential buyers for the two divisions. The company is also preparing to sell its cement technology and raw materials processing activities.

Reorganisation is continuing at KHD Humboldt Wedag despite continued efforts to sell the unit, which was the source of the original losses that led to the one-billion-mark bailout last year by the company's creditor banks led by Deutsche Bank AG.
